summary: TheRealReal, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an October 9, 2026 Credit Agreement with Fortress Credit Corp. as administrative and collateral agent, providing a $150 million senior secured term loan and a $25 million revolver. Proceeds, plus cash, will fully redeem the existing 4.25%/8.75% PIK/Cash Senior Secured Notes due 2029 on or about October 19, 2026. Pricing is adjusted Term SOFR plus 5.75%, with leverage-based step-downs, 0.25% quarterly amortization, seven-year maturity, springing maturity 91 days before the 2031 convertible notes, and first-priority liens. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation. Watch redemption timing and leverage covenants.
